Mode of Procurement (a) Procurement will be through GeM, either as a Custom Bid (since a catalogue item matching th ese exact specifications may not be available). (b) The bid will be evaluated on L1 (lowest price) basis among technically qualified bidders fo r the entire lot, with no part or split award. 5. Terms and Conditions (to be incorporated in the bid) 1. Eligibility: The bidder must be a registered seller on GeM with a valid GST registration and PAN. Th e bidder should have prior experience in printing booklets/publications, with a work order or comple tion certificate from a government department/organisation for similar work. 2. Design and proofing: The vendor will provide a soft copy and a hard-copy proof before final printi ng. Printing will start only after written approval of the proof by the Board. Any errors in Hindi text, s pelling or matra will be corrected by the vendor at its own cost. 3. Quality: The booklet will be in sharp, full colour with good registration. The cover will be on 250 GS M paper with gloss/matt lamination [specify], and the inner pages on 170 GSM paper of the specifie d quality. The booklet will have 32 pages, be of size 13 x 10.5 cm, and have a durable binding. The Board may reject copies with misprints, smudging, cut or loose pages, or poor binding. The vendor will replace rejected copies at its own cost within 15 days. 4. Delivery period: Delivery of the complete lot must be within 3 weeks of the supply order/contract . Delivery will be made at the Board’s office, at the vendor’s cost, including packing, loading, unloa ding and transport. 5. Delivery in full lot: Partial delivery is acceptable only with prior approval of the Board. 6. Liquidated damages: For delay, LD at 0.5% of the contract value per week (or part thereof) up to a maximum of 10%, as per GeM General Terms and Conditions. 7. Inspection and acceptance: The Board’s officer will inspect the supplies before acceptance. Pay ment will be released only after satisfactory receipt and acceptance. 8. Payment: 100% payment within [30] days of delivery, inspection and acceptance, on submission of invoice on GeM, subject to applicable TDS and GST provisions. 9. Taxes: Rates must be inclusive of all taxes, duties and charges, with GST shown separately. 10. Rate validity: Bid validity of two months from the bid opening date. 11. Intellectual property and confidentiality: The content and design remain the property of the Bo ard. The vendor may not reuse, reproduce, sell or share the content, and must return/delete all soft files after completion.

12. Subcontracting: Not allowed without the prior permission of the Board. 13. Dispute and jurisdiction: Disputes will be settled as per GeM terms, with jurisdiction at courts in Chandigarh. 14. Right of the Board: The Board may accept or reject any or all bids, or cancel the process without assigning reasons. 15. GeM general terms: The GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) as amended from time to time will apply in addition to the above. .
